name: What are the advantages of installing a full tile backsplash over painted drywall?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of installing a full tile backsplash over painted drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile is standard for kitchen splash zones and floors because it resists moisture, stains, and daily heat exposure better than standard drywall or paint. While painted drywall is less expensive initially, it absorbs grease splatters and stains quickly, requiring frequent repainting and patch repairs. Porcelain tile and natural stone provide a durable, wipe-clean barrier that protects your walls from water intrusion behind the sink. Incorporating custom tile work, marble accents, and detailed finish molding also enhances the finished quality and long-term durability of the renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile creates a moisture- and stain-resistant barrier behind sinks and cooktops that wipes clean easily, preventing moisture damage to drywall.
